_README: Schema for tools/disclosure-targets.json — the active disclosure-window
target list. The actual file is gitignored and lives only on the maintainer's
machine until the disclosure window closes.
Each target has a public MCP-server URL plus a security contact, sourced from
the vendor's /.well-known/security.txt or their published security page.
1. modelcontextprotocol/servers org + the homepage registry list
3. Vendor MCP announcements (Atlassian, Notion, Cloudflare, Linear, ...)
4. GitHub code search for 'oauth-protected-resource' on *.mcp.* hosts
Anything that fails GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource gets dropped
before the scan; we never publish 'this URL doesn't host an MCP server'.

targets.name: Example Vendor MCP
targets.notes: Optional human-readable provenance — where the URL came from.
